subject: FinWise: load test coordination / k6 scripts & IP allowlist
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Liu <jenny@finwise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinWise: post‑call recap + next steps (load test coordination)

Thanks again for taking time today, Jenny — good conversation. Recap and proposed next steps below so we’re aligned for the customer‑led load test: 

Summary from call:
- Performance targets: 95th pctl latency <= 300ms for streaming responses, p50 <= 120ms for non‑streaming.
- Throughput targets: sustained 1,200 requests/sec for the core inference route, peak bursts to 2,000 rps for 10s.
- Concurrency: expect ~600 concurrent open connections for streaming tests.
- Streaming: SSE chunking enabled; client consumes partial tokens as they arrive.

Next steps (proposed):
1) We’ll provide a k6 script bundle and a short load test plan (ramp/hold/peak) by EOD Mon.
2) You provide test window(s) and confirm IPs to allowlist; we’ll provide the static egress IPs from our test runner.
3) We’ll provision a short‑lived test account + API key and a dedicated test model variant if you want to isolate traffic.
4) Marissa (SE) will validate the target endpoints and recommend any client adjustments for streaming.

I’m attaching the initial k6 scripts and a draft load test plan — please review and let us know any adjustments to the ramp profile or windows.

Attachments: k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz (contains k6 scripts & README), finwise-loadtest-plan-20260301.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142

---

From: Jenny Liu <jenny@finwise.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: FinWise Ops <ops@finwise.com>, Will Park <will.park@finwise.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinWise: post‑call recap + next steps (load test coordination)

Thanks, Aditya — this looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Test windows: we prefer Wed 3/3 00:00–04:00 PT for the first soak test and Fri 3/5 01:00–03:00 PT for the peak/burst test. Can you confirm availability?
- IP allowlist: we’ll need the list of source IPs (or CIDR) used by Redwood’s test runners so our infra team can pre‑approve.
- Streaming behavior: streaming must preserve chunk order and not buffer large tokens (we’ll validate traces).

On the test account: we’d like a creds file and a short expiration (48 hrs) for the sandbox key. Also please share the endpoint URL and any headers we should set.

Will loop in ops; they’ll confirm the allowlist once they have the IPs.

—Jenny
Head of Integrations | FinWise

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Liu <jenny@finwise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinWise: post‑call recap + next steps (load test coordination)

Thanks Jenny — confirmed on our side for both windows. Internal owners (cc’d) will own the tech handoff and the runner IPs.

What we’re sending you now:
- k6 scripts bundle (attached) with a README describing flags and env vars.
- Draft load test plan (attached) with recommended ramp profiles: 5m ramp to 1,200 rps, 20m steady, 2m burst to 2,000 rps, cool down 5m.
- Short‑lived test creds (we’ll share secure link with ops) — note: we will rotate the key after the first window automatically.

Proposed allowlist entries (these are NATed egress IPs from our runner pool):
- 34.201.128.12/32
- 34.201.128.13/32
- 34.201.128.14/32

If you need a CIDR instead of /32s we can provide aggregates; Marissa will validate the runners before the window.

Attachments: k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz, finwise-loadtest-plan-20260301.pdf, test-account-creds.txt (link to S3,UAT)

Aditya

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jenny Liu <jenny@finwise.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinWise: post‑call recap + next steps (load test coordination)

Hey team — technical notes and a few small asks ahead of Wed’s soak: 

1) Endpoints and headers
- Inference endpoint (sandbox): https://api.sandbox.redwood.com/v1/finwise-infer
- Header: Authorization: Bearer <TEST_KEY>
- For streaming tests use the /v1/finwise-infer?stream=true param; responses are chunked with SSE framing.

2) k6 usage notes (included in README):
- Example run: k6 run --vus 600 --duration 20m scripts/streaming_test.js --env HOST=https://api.sandbox.redwood.com --env API_KEY=<TEST_KEY>
- We translate VUs to concurrent streaming connections; for your target ~600 concurrent streams set --vus 600 and use the streaming script.
- Ramp profile (recommended): stages: [{duration: '5m', target: 1200}, {duration: '20m', target:1200}, {duration:'2m', target:2000}, {duration:'5m', target:0}] (scripts include these stages).

3) SLO validation points
- We capture server side timing: request_start, first_chunk_ms, last_chunk_ms, total_tokens. Please share the metric thresholds you want reported in the post‑test summary (we’ll include p50/p95/p99).

4) IPs & network
- Aditya shared three runner IPs. Ops: please confirm whether you want us to run from these specific IPs or if we should use the runner pool (we can pin to the three above).

5) Test credentials
- We created a sandbox key that expires in 48h. Download link (S3, expiring): https://s3.redwood.internal/finwise/test-creds-20260301.txt
- For security we recommend restricting the test key to the sandbox model only.

Attachments (technical): k6-scripts-v1.tar.gz (contains streaming_test.js, nonstream_test.js, README), finwise-loadtest-plan-20260301.pdf

If everything looks good I’ll schedule a short pre‑test call 30m before Wed’s window to validate connectivity.

Thanks,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

---

From: Will Park <will.park@finwise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jenny Liu <jenny@finwise.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinWise: post‑call recap + next steps (load test coordination)

Thanks—this is exactly what we needed. Ops will add the three /32s to our allowlist for the Wed window. Two quick asks: 
1) Can you confirm the exact header name for streaming heartbeats so we can filter logs?
2) Please send the pre‑test join URL (for the 30m call) and we’ll have a person from infra ready.

We’ll confirm once allowlist changes are in place.

—Will
Platform Reliability | FinWise
